x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

mna = -1
mnb = -1

def calc(a, b):
    global mna, mnb
    if a < 0:
        return
    if mna == -1:
        mna = a
        mnb = b
        return
    if abs(mnb * x - mna * y) * b > abs(b * x - a * y) * mnb:
        mna = a
        mnb = b
    elif (abs(mnb * x - mna * y) * b == abs(b * x - a * y) * mnb) and (b < mnb or (b == mnb and a < mna)):
        mna = a
        mnb = b

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    cur = i * x // y
    a = cur - 1
    calc(a, i)
    a = cur
    calc(a, i)
    a = cur + 1
    calc(a, i)

print(f"{mna}/{mnb}")
